name: io.github.Servosity/sophos-central-mcp
title: Sophos Central MCP
description: The Sophos Central partner, organization and tenant APIs, routed to the right tenant and region

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of a Sophos Central API credential (Partner Dashboard > Settings & Policies > API Credentials, or Global Settings > API Credentials Management).

environmentVariables.name: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of that API credential. Sophos shows it only once, when the credential is created.
